title: Jack Parsons' blond alien in the Mojave
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jack Parsons' blond alien in the Mojave, about 1948 at Mojave Desert, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he also claimed to have encountered a blond-haired alien following a ritual in the Mojave Desert in 1948
According to legendary French UFO researcher Jacques Vallee, there were rumors of a ritual in the Mojave where a blonde woman appeared and claimed to be from Venus.
tellings.difference: Relayed as a rumor from Jacques Vallee, with the being a blonde woman who claimed to be from Venus and no year given.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of a blond being who appeared after a Parsons ritual in the Mojave Desert.

as_told.title: Venusian blonde woman at a Mojave ritual

tellings.quote: and I know Jack Parsons thought he was in touch with, you know, other beings and literally saw like a what you could describe as a Nordic alien woman, you know, while he was testing rockets, you know, in California. uh in the Mojave Desert.
tellings.difference: Places the encounter during rocket testing rather than after a ritual, and gives no year.
tellings.link_reason: Jack Parsons encountering a blond, Nordic-type alien in the Mojave Desert.

as_told.title: Jack Parsons sees a Nordic alien woman while testing rockets

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Jack Parsons, an American rocket pioneer, claimed to have met a blond-haired alien after performing a ritual in the Mojave Desert in California in 1948. Michels tells it as part of a picture in which early rocketry, the occult and contact with other beings are tangled together.
